question: Which 4.100.108 addresses hold the firmware version and build identity strings?
prototype_hypothesis: The 4.100.108 image stores version/build identity in a ro.* property block near XIP 0x0CA00440 (ro.build.version=4.100.108, ro.build.id=user-4.100.108-cn-202607230300), each line `key=value\n`-terminated with a NUL after the block.
callsite_evidence:
Raw binary at file offset 0x940440 holds the ASCII property block: "...ro.build.version=4.100.108
ro.product.device.screenshape=pill-shaped
ro.product.device.devicetype=band
ro.sf.lcd_density=320
ro.build.id=user-4.100.108-cn-202607230300
\0"
The version value `4.100.108` appears at address 0x0CA0045E (within the ro.build.version line); the full build id `user-4.100.108-cn-202607230300` starts at address 0x0CA004D6
IDA string listing confirms the property block is a single contiguous C string; no standalone NUL-terminated `4.100.108\0` exists anywhere in the image

Unlike 3.101.036 (which had a dedicated early-XIP identity area at 0x0C0C0810/0x0C0C0850), 4.100.108 moved identity into the property table, so the identity guard must read the property-formatted strings
control_flow_evidence: The version and build values are consumed by the firmware's property system (ro.build.* getters), not by a direct string reference from a fixed identity symbol

The identity guard's canopus_str_neq compares byte-by-byte until NUL; because the property lines are `key=value\n`-terminated (NUL only after the whole block), a direct comparison of the expected bare version against the value start will mismatch on the `\n`
Target-private must therefore either (a) set the expected string to include the `key=` prefix and trailing newline, or (b) read the version through the firmware's property accessor
ownership_analysis: Read-only firmware strings. The addresses are stable within this exact image and are safe for a read-only identity comparison.
unsafe_assumptions: The property block layout is recovered from this exact image and is not portable to other firmware versions
The identity guard behavior with `key=value\n` strings is not yet validated; the symbol records stay PENDING until the guard string format is decided and host-tested
recommended_probe: After deciding the guard string format, run the identity guard on-device and confirm it accepts the exact 4.100.108 image and rejects a neighboring version.
